title: MCP Tool Index
description: Maps every MCP server tool to tags (for categorical filtering) and intent (for semantic matching). Lives at .ai-badger/mcp-tools.json in scaffolded projects (a legacy .ai-badger/mcp-tools.yaml is migrated automatically the first time a write command runs).

version.description: Index format version (not ai-badger framework version).

generated_at.description: ISO-8601 timestamp of last index generation.

name.description: MCP server name as the host CLI that listed it prints it (`hermes mcp list`, `claude mcp list`).

url.description: MCP server endpoint URL (for HTTP/SSE servers).

status.description: What the host's last listing said about this server: 'ok' (tools reported), 'disabled' (the host says it is switched off), 'empty' (enabled, asked, exposed nothing), 'unknown' (the listing carried no tool detail — the `hermes mcp list` text table, or a `claude mcp list` server that is merely Connected), 'absent' (the host no longer lists it; its tools are marked removed), 'unreachable' / 'unauthenticated' / 'pending_approval' (`claude mcp list` reports these distinctly: Failed to connect, Needs authentication, Pending approval). Each has a different remedy, which is why a zero-tool server is recorded rather than dropped (ADR-0014 decision 7). The enum is additive: a status is added only once some host CLI is observed reporting it.

tags.description: Category tags from the closed taxonomy in features/common/mcp-tags.json.

intent.description: Human-readable one-sentence description of what the tool accomplishes. Used for semantic matching.

status.description: Set to 'removed' when the MCP server no longer exposes this tool (preserves manual tags for later re-addition).

origin.description: Where this entry's tags and intent came from: 'catalog' (features/<stack>/mcp/<server>/tools.json), 'heuristic' (_auto_tags guessing from the tool name), 'manual' (mcp-index tag/intent). Per tool, not per server: a catalog-described server also exposes tools the catalog does not describe. Only 'manual' survives a later `mcp-index update`.
